slides.heading: Department of Health (DOH)
slides.subtitle: The national agency that leads the health sector to assure quality health care for all Filipinos.

slides.heading: Vision, Mission & Functions (E.O. 102)
bullets: Vision: Filipinos among the healthiest in Southeast Asia by 2022 and Asia by 2040.
Mission: lead a productive, resilient, equitable and people-centered health system.
E.O. 102 — 3 functions: Leadership in health (policies); Enabler & capacity builder (strategy & training); Administrative (manage tertiary/specialty/emergency hospitals).
Goal: National Objectives for Health — the roadmap, evaluated every 5 years.

slides.heading: Local Government Code 1991 (RA 7160)
bullets: Decentralization & devolution — transfer of power for health services.
DOH formulates programs; the LGU implements them.
Provincial government (governor = chairman) governs SECONDARY facilities; vice-chair = PHO.
Municipal/city government (mayor = chairman) governs PRIMARY facilities; vice-chair = MHO/CHO.

slides.heading: Health Sector Reform Agenda (HSRA)
bullets: Fiscal autonomy to government hospitals.
Secure funding for priority public health programs.
Develop local health systems and ensure performance.
Strengthen health regulatory agencies.
Expand coverage of the National Health Insurance Program.

slides.heading: FOURmula One for Health (Arroyo)
bullets: Goals: better health outcomes, more responsive systems, equitable health financing.
Elements: health financing, health regulation, health service delivery, good governance.

slides.heading: F1 PLUS — FOURmula One Plus (Duterte)
bullets: Theme: boosting universal health care.

Pillars: (1) Health financing — NHIP/PhilHealth (case-rate, per diagnosis); (2) Health regulation; (3) Health services delivery; (4) Good governance (transparent, accountable, efficient); (5) Performance accountability (outcome-based).

slides.heading: Universal Health Care Act (RA 11223)
bullets: Theme: Pangkalahatang kalusugan.
All Filipinos are automatically enrolled in PhilHealth.
Thrusts: financial risk protection (expanded NHIP), improved access to quality facilities, attainment of health-related MDGs.

terms.definition: 8 Millennium Development Goals — incl. reduce child mortality, improve maternal health, combat HIV/malaria.
17 Sustainable Development Goals — incl. No. 3 Good health and well-being.

slides.heading: Key Takeaways
bullets: DOH formulates; LGUs implement (devolution under RA 7160).
Province → secondary facilities; municipality/city → primary facilities.
RA 11223 (UHC) = automatic PhilHealth enrollment for all Filipinos.
Know the worker ratios: PHN 1:10,000, midwife 1:5,000, physician 1:20,000.
